traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are met. normalizeCommentLine now strips backtick-wrapped content using a centralized regex-based filter, replacing matches with spaces to preserve character boundaries. Unit tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts cover ignoring inline-code references, preserving spacing, handling multiple backtick segments, correctly detecting real annotations outside backticks, and leaving non-backtick lines unchanged. The helper’s JSDoc documents the inline-code filtering behavior, and a full Jest run shows all 42 suites (including these new tests) passing, satisfying the no-regression requirement.
